newsitem.title: USA: PGA GOLF-SCORES FROM PEBBLE BEACH AFTER THE FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: PGA GOLF-SCORES FROM PEBBLE BEACH AFTER THE FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Leading scores after the first round of the $1.9 million AT&T Pebble Beach National Pro-am golf tournament on Thursday (all players U.S. unless noted):
66 Tom Lehman, Brian Henninger, Billy Andrade
67 Nick Faldo (Britain), Willie Wood, Phil Mickelson, Vijay Singh (Fiji), Paul Stankowski, Jim Furyk, Mark Brooks, Mark O'Meara, Skip Kendall

68 John Wilson, Naomichi "Joe" Ozaki (Japan), Fred Funk, Craig Kanada, Scott Gump, Frank Lickliter, Justin Leonard, Tom Watson, Lee Rinker, Emlyn Aubrey, Fulton Allem (South Africa), Ted Tryba, Steve Jones, Larry Silveira, Mike Hulbert
70 Steve Elkington (Australia), David Frost (South Africa), Grant Waite (New Zealand), Shigeki Maruyama (Japan)
72 Howard Clark (Britain), Phil Tataurangi (New Zealand), Sandy Lyle (Britain), Rafael Alarcon (Mexico), Shinichi Yokota (Japan)
